decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher stays close to the core postpress offer and fits existing sales and service routines, and with no reported shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular systems and costs little to carry, so the firm's slack makes keeping it reasonable even though its own results are less visible.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship within the core business and supports the push toward automated finishing, so after dropping B the firm focuses its resources on such core flagships.
The hybrid saddle stitcher serves established booklet-making demand with existing service capabilities, and there is no evidence of underperformance that would justify withdrawal.
The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation in combination with the Touchline line, which shows results meeting aspirations close to the core offer.
